source_refs.note: i. Thermal Stability: a main subheading of 33.1 Properties and Quality of Water, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 247-247.

blocks.text: The polarity of the water molecule results in the formation of hydrogen bonds between water molecules. Hydrogen bonding gives water a high specific heat capacity and high heat of vaporisation. This means that large bodies of water are thermally stable, resisting rapid temperature changes.
